name: dropdown-menu
title: DropdownMenu
description: Click a trigger and a menu drops with actions or nested groups. App chrome and overflow menus.

discovery.name: DropdownMenu
discovery.description: Click a trigger and a menu drops with actions or nested groups. App chrome and overflow menus.

configurables.what: Controlled open state of the menu.
configurables.how: Omit for uncontrolled (internal state). Pass open + onOpenChange when a parent must sync (toolbars, command palettes).

gotchas.note: Controlled: open + onOpenChange together. Content side/align live on DropdownMenuContent (bottom/start defaults), not on the root.
Trigger exposes aria-expanded and aria-haspopup=menu; keep menu items keyboard Enter/Space activatable.
